_comment: PROPOSAL ONLY -- NOT AN AUTHORIZATION RECORD. No code in this repository reads this file. system/evaluation/replay_harness.py's CampaignExecutionNotAuthorizedError is raised unconditionally by execute_experiment_a/execute_experiment_b regardless of this file's contents, and this pass does not wire this file into any check -- see N6_CONSOLIDATED_READINESS_REMEDIATION_REPORT.md Workstream 2 for why. This is a PROPOSED SCHEMA, modeled on the existing, in-production precedent experiments/exp_three_arm_2024/AUTHORIZATION_RECORD.json (schema v2), adapted to name the smallest defensible authorization this specific future N6-vs-baseline multi-origin comparison would need. Every signer/hash/decision field below is null or a placeholder string; none is a real signature, hash, or approval. Filling in this template does not authorize anything by itself -- it would only become meaningful if a project owner/governance authority FIRST decided to (a) extend replay_harness.py with a checked-record mechanism analogous to experiments/exp_three_arm_2024/scripts/preflight.py's check_authorization(), and (b) that extension itself passed its own governance review (a code change to a safety-relevant gate, not a bounded engineering task this pass is authorized to make unilaterally).
proposal_status: DRAFT_PROPOSAL -- NOT IMPLEMENTED, NOT SIGNED, NOT AUTHORIZED

required_signer_authority.base_record_rationale: Matches the existing exp_three_arm_2024 precedent for a bounded, offline, research-labeled comparison that makes no production-promotion claim. The same single role ('project lead', case-insensitive exact match) that experiments/exp_three_arm_2024/scripts/preflight.py:298 already requires in code for that experiment.
required_signer_authority.additional_signer_rationale: If any future report derived from this comparison is used to argue for production promotion, SAF-05's four SAFETY_GATE_REGISTRY gates (register ID SAF-05, disposition BLOCKED_BY_AUTHORIZATION) would ALSO need a separate, independent governance-authority sign-off -- distinct from, and in addition to, this record's project-lead signature. This proposal does not conflate the two; a signed base record below would authorize ONLY the comparison's execution, never a promotion claim.

scope_excludes: Any production control-flow change (PROTECTED_FILES remain untouched by this experiment regardless of this record).
Any claim of SAF-05 production-promotion governance approval (tracked and signed independently, if ever sought).
Any DSL-01 Candidate-2 (Net-Deficit EBR) research-acceptance verdict (DSL-01's own epsilon_tol preregistration gate is separate and independent of this record).
Any re-opening of the sealed 2025 blind partition.

origin_set.description: An explicit, named, finite list of forecast-origin timestamps (or a hash of a frozen origin-list file), matching exactly the origins passed to build_multi_origin_campaign_config. No wildcard, 'all available', or open-ended origin set is acceptable -- mirrors exp_three_arm_2024's fixed 123-origin set.

arms.description: Exactly two named forecast providers: the baseline (e.g. 'causal_nwp_gamma1') and the candidate ('n6_solar'), matching ScenarioSpec.forecast_provider on both sides of the matched pair. A record naming any provider forecast_lineage.py classifies as an oracle/leakage provider (ORACLE_PROVIDER_NAMES) must be rejected at the preflight-equivalent check, independent of and in addition to ScenarioSpec.__post_init__'s own existing reject_if_oracle call.

required_fields_per_signed_section.signer_name: Full name of the individual signing.
required_fields_per_signed_section.signer_role: Must equal 'project lead' (case-insensitive), matching required_signer_authority above.
required_fields_per_signed_section.harness_code_sha256: SHA-256 of system/evaluation/n6_multi_origin_harness/harness.py AT THE EXACT COMMIT being authorized -- binds the authorization to this specific implementation, not a future edited version. Not present in the exp_three_arm_2024 precedent (which has no equivalent reusable harness module); added here because this harness, unlike a one-off experiment script, could in principle be edited after a comparison is authorized, which the exp_three_arm_2024 precedent's existing calibration_artifact_sha256/experiment_config_sha256 pair does not need to guard against.
required_fields_per_signed_section.cross_arm_reproducibility_manifest_sha25: SHA-256 of the assembled system.evaluation.n6_multi_origin_harness.reproducibility_manifest.CrossArmReproducibilityManifest JSON serialization for this specific run -- see N6_CONSOLIDATED_READINESS_REMEDIATION_REPORT.md Workstream 4. Ensures the authorization is bound to one specific, already-cited set of input/code/config hashes, not merely to 'the harness exists'.
required_fields_per_signed_section.package_manifest_sha256: As in the exp_three_arm_2024 precedent: hash of the full staged experiment package.
required_fields_per_signed_section.experiment_config_sha256: As in the exp_three_arm_2024 precedent: hash of this comparison's own configuration file (origins, arms, controller settings, expected_steps per origin).

execute_section_additional_fields.solve_ceiling: int, exactly equal to n_origins * 2 (arms) * expected_steps_per_origin -- the total solve-budget ceiling, mirroring exp_three_arm_2024's solve_ceiling check.
execute_section_additional_fields.execute_instruction_ref: Must be non-empty and must name the project lead's own separate, explicit 'execute' instruction, by content hash and recording timestamp -- never the same instruction that approved preflight/calibration. Must not already be 'consumed' by a prior run's RUN_STATUS.json-equivalent (single-use guard, mirroring exp_three_arm_2024's AUTHORIZATION_RECORD.json history-entry-2 consumption pattern).

one_time_instruction_consumption.mechanism_proposed: Identical in spirit to exp_three_arm_2024: an execute_instruction_ref is consumed the first time a run starts against it, regardless of outcome, and can never authorize a second execution under any circumstance. A new execute_instruction_ref (naming a new, separate project-lead instruction) would be required for any re-run, including a re-run after a failed/incomplete first attempt.

rejection_behavior.no_such_check_exists_in_code_today: CampaignExecutionNotAuthorizedError is raised before any of the above could even be evaluated -- this record's existence or completeness changes nothing about that today.

approving_authority_summary: Base record: the project owner, acting in the 'project lead' role, exactly as already established for exp_three_arm_2024. Additional, independent sign-off: a governance authority, ONLY if and when results are used for a production-promotion claim (SAF-05), which this proposal does not assume will happen and does not bundle into the base record.
what_this_proposal_does_not_do: Does not create, forge, or self-approve any authorization.
Does not modify replay_harness.py's unconditional CampaignExecutionNotAuthorizedError.
Does not implement check_authorization()-equivalent code for this harness (that code change would itself need its own governance review before being made, per this pass's own boundaries).
Does not select an origin set, arm pair, or any hash value -- every 'value' field above is null by design.
